blocks.text: Hyde Park — Zenterra Townhomes with Retained Parkland in Grandview Surrey

parts.t: Hyde Park

is a townhome community by Zenterra Developments near 28 Avenue and 156 Street in Grandview Surrey. It has 156 homes, and about three acres of the site were kept as natural parkland with old-growth Douglas fir trees.

At the centre of the community is the Lancaster Club, a 5,500 sq ft, two-level clubhouse for residents with a fitness studio, a media room, a games room, a multipurpose sport court and a kitchen for gatherings.
Grandview Corners shopping is about 1 km away, and The Shops at Morgan Crossing are a short drive south.

Hyde Park was built with several floor plans, including tandem-garage, double-garage and main-floor primary bedroom layouts, so size and bedroom count vary from home to home. Many have open-concept main floors, and the original homes came with Zenterra's “Signature Entertainment Wall” with an electric fireplace in the living room.
Every main level has a powder room, and garages are tandem or double depending on the plan. Contact Jared for the floor plan and square footage of any unit you're considering.
Strata & Ownership

blocks.text: What to Check Before You Buy

parts.t: Hyde Park is registered as strata plan EPS2381. Monthly fees and what they cover can change, so review the current fee schedule, bylaws, depreciation report and recent minutes before you write an offer.
Hyde Park Corner, a separate 16-townhome phase at 2828 156 Street completed in 2021, has its own strata plan, so check which strata a listing belongs to.

What is the typical price range for Hyde Park townhomes?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared at 604-928-1361 for recent Hyde Park sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at Hyde Park?

Sizes vary at Hyde Park because it was built with several plan types, including tandem-garage, double-garage and main-floor primary bedroom layouts. Contact Jared for the exact square footage and bedroom count of a specific unit.
Are rentals allowed at Hyde Park?

Hyde Park is a 156-home Zenterra townhome community (strata plan EPS2381). Since BC’s Strata Property Act was amended on November 24, 2022, a strata corporation can no longer restrict long-term rentals, so the strata cannot cap or ban them. Bylaws limiting short-term rentals can still apply. Buyers should review the current bylaws and recent minutes and confirm the rules with the strata manager before buying.
What schools serve Hyde Park?

Hyde Park and Hyde Park Corner are in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). Several private schools are a short drive away.
How competitive is the Hyde Park market?

It depends on the unit and the market at the time. Floor plan, updates and price all affect how a Hyde Park home sells, so contact Jared for recent Hyde Park sales and comparable listings before you set a price or make an offer.
Are there homes for sale at Hyde Park right now?
Listings at Hyde Park come and go quickly. Use the South Surrey townhome links in the availability box above, or call or text me at 604-928-1361 and I'll set up an alert for new Hyde Park listings.
What should I check before buying at Hyde Park?
Ask for the Form B information certificate, the strata bylaws and rules, the last two years of minutes and the depreciation report. I review these with every buyer before subjects are removed.
